summary.en: Two exits from the stadium: shorter fury, or thicker armor.
summary.zh: 离开体育馆的两个出口：更短的怒火，或更厚的铠甲。

sound.en: Three-chord spit, thrash precision, frost on the bassline
sound.zh: 三和弦唾沫、Thrash 精度、贝斯线上的霜

body.en:
Punk had already kicked the door; the eighties decide what to do with the wreckage. The Clash prove urgency can travel. Joy Division turn cold rooms into hymns. Metal hardens into its own nation-state—Sabbath's children learn speed and discipline; Metallica takes the grammar global.

If the seventies were empires, the eighties are factions with better jackets and worse sleep.
body.zh:
Punk 已经踹过门；八十年代决定拿残骸怎么办。The Clash 证明紧迫感可以上路。Joy Division 把冷房间写成圣歌。Metal 硬化成自己的民族国家——Sabbath 的孩子们学会速度与纪律；Metallica 把语法带向全球。

如果说七十年代是帝国，八十年代就是夹克更好、睡眠更差的派系。
